children: Charles Schwab's third-quarter core net new assets reached $190.4 billion, up 38% from a year earlier, driven by strong inflows from both independent advisors and retail investors. Advisor Services brought in $120.1 billion while Investor Services gathered $72.3 billion. The firm's wealth management offerings saw particular strength, with Pledged Asset Line balances climbing 59% year-over-year to $37.3 billion. Net flows into Schwab Wealth Advisory rose 55% compared with 3Q25. President and Chief Executive Rick Wurster said clients continue to turn to Schwab for its broad wealth, trading, and banking capabilities
